Current_exposure: Iframe/image modes exist; no licenses reviewed

Current_exposure: Static curated links and embeds depend on external hosts

Current_exposure: Not observed as current feature; high future exposure

Current_exposure: No verified traffic or revenue baseline

Current_exposure: Small catalog; future scale could create low-value pages

Current_exposure: Acquisition mix unknown
